title: cyclosorus micans
intro: Cyclosorus micans, commonly known as the Black Rattan fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Cyclosorus micans are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids that have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the plant's effects and to confirm its efficacy in treating various health conditions.
